transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get next week's sustainment-training board finalized and published by 1600 today. We've got the driver-certification block and the radio-procedures refresher for support personnel to schedule. The training yard is available Monday through Friday, and normally we slot driver-certification on Tuesday morning. Before I sign off on the final board, I need the S-3 and motor pool chief to report any schedule or readiness changes at our weekly training huddle. Specifically, I need to confirm whether all six training trucks are released and available for the standard driver-cert block. Let's hear from the S-3 and motor pool chief first.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a schedule change. I received a higher-headquarters tasking this morning requiring 2nd Platoon to complete a radio-procedures refresher on Wednesday from 1300 to 1500, with an attendance roster submitted afterward. This tasking is still being entered into the battalion training tracker and is not yet on the briefing slide, so it's not visible to anyone else yet. We'll need to account for this when we finalize the sustainment-training board today.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Sir, I need to report a readiness change regarding the training trucks. During this morning's inspection, I confirmed that only four of the six assigned training trucks have completed brake inspections. The other two trucks will not be released until Friday at 0800, and this inspection status has not yet been posted to the training board. Those two trucks must remain on hold until their inspections are complete, so we will not have all six trucks available for a standard driver-certification block on Tuesday morning.
transcript.speaker: A3
